annotations.title: Calculate Korea join leave month insurance

description: South Korea social insurance in the joining and leaving months for an employee: national pension, health, long-term care and employment insurance start the month after joining (the joining month if joined on the 1st; pension also if the employee opts in) and run through the month of the last working day (coverage lost the next day). Monthly employee shares at 2026 rates with the pension floor and cap. Employment insurance in the leaving month is flagged, not computed. Cites 국민건강보험법 제69조②, 국민연금법 제17조·제12조, 보험료징수법 제16조의4.

leave.description: Last working day YYYY-MM-DD (omit if still employed)

pensionFromJoinMonth.description: Joined mid-month but chose to pay pension from the joining month

untilMonth.description: Last month to list when still employed (YYYY-MM)
